name.es: Rodamiento de bolas con pestaña F695 (5 × 13 × 4, pestaña 15 × 1)
name.fr: Roulement à billes à collerette F695 (5 × 13 × 4, collerette 15 × 1)
name.pt: Rolamento de esferas com flange F695 (5 × 13 × 4, flange 15 × 1)

description.en: A miniature deep groove ball bearing with a flange on its outer ring: 5 mm bore, 13 mm outside diameter, 4 mm wide, with a 15 mm flange 1 mm thick. Two of them, flanges outward, make a smooth belt idler on an M5 screw; one can also seat in a housing on its flange.
description.es: Un rodamiento rígido de bolas miniatura con pestaña en el anillo exterior: barreno de 5 mm, diámetro exterior de 13 mm, 4 mm de ancho, con una pestaña de 15 mm y 1 mm de espesor. Dos de ellos, con las pestañas hacia afuera, forman una polea loca lisa sobre un tornillo M5; uno solo también puede asentar en un alojamiento sobre su pestaña.
description.fr: Un roulement rigide à billes miniature avec une collerette sur la bague extérieure : alésage de 5 mm, diamètre extérieur de 13 mm, largeur de 4 mm, collerette de 15 mm et 1 mm d'épaisseur. Deux d'entre eux, collerettes vers l'extérieur, forment un galet lisse sur une vis M5 ; un seul peut aussi se loger dans un logement en appui sur sa collerette.
description.pt: Um rolamento rígido de esferas miniatura com flange no anel exterior: furo de 5 mm, diâmetro exterior de 13 mm, 4 mm de largura, com uma flange de 15 mm e 1 mm de espessura. Dois deles, com as flanges para fora, formam uma polia louca lisa num parafuso M5; um só também pode assentar num alojamento apoiado na flange.

sources.title: NSK F695ZZ flanged miniature deep groove ball bearing (product page F695ZZMC5)
sources.supports: F695ZZ: bore d 5 mm; outside diameter D 13 mm; width B 4 mm; flange diameter D1 15 mm; flange width C1 1 mm; chamfer r min 0.2 mm; shields both sides

sources.title: Voron 2.4r2 build guide, version 2023-07-04 (VoronDesign/Voron-2 @ a192410, Manual/Assembly_Manual_2.4r2.pdf, GPL-3.0); cited by page and section only, nothing copied
sources.supports: p. 8 (Hardware reference): F695 flanged bearings in the gantry; pp. 65 and 69 (A/B Drives and Idlers) and pp. 97 and 99 (Gantry, XY joints): two F695 between M5 shims on an M5x40 SHCS, flanges outward

frame_convention: Origin at the centre of face A, the flange side, on the axis. +z runs along the axis to face B, the plain side, at z = 4. The flange occupies z 0 to 1 out to Ø15; the outer ring's Ø13 seat runs from z = 1 to 4. +x is an arbitrary radial reference: the bearing is round, so every interface has continuous symmetry.

interfaces.note: Female: the bore receives the screw's shank. Framed at face A (the flange side), normal −z out of the face.
Neutral: the flange side bears on the next part of a stack (a shim).
Neutral: the plain side bears on the next part of a stack; two F695 meet plain face to plain face, flanges outward.

Male: the outer ring goes into a Ø13 housing bore until the flange's underside (z = 1) lands on the housing face. The normal points +z, the side the housing lies on, so a seat framed at its entrance (normal out of the cavity) takes the bearing face B first.

running_diameter.note: datasheet symbol D: the outer ring's cylindrical surface between the flanges, which the belt runs on

belt_engagement.plane_note: Convention: the guide's idler stacks (pp. 65, 69, 97, 99) put two F695 plain face to plain face, flanges outward, so the belt runs on both outer rings between the two flanges and its mid-plane is the plain-face junction, z = 4 (face B) of either bearing; a path via may name either bearing of the pair and lands on the same circle. A single F695 used another way needs its own plane. The axis is the bore axis.

review_status.note: Drafted in one pass by an agent (P4-AUTH-E lane, 2026-10-04); facts read from the cited sources on the access date; no language facet has had a native review.

notes: The catalog key equals the interface-sizes key bearing-f695, which describes the same part's housing fit.
